dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Mommy is the bestest person in the whole-wide world! Albedo knows!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #She knows everyone. I'm sure she knows {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #When she comes back, we have to go and find her. She's a really good person, {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight will definitely like her!
